newsitem.title: FRANCE: KAL lifting ex-Paris air cargo rates April.
newsitem.headline: KAL lifting ex-Paris air cargo rates April.

text.p: Korean Airlines (KAL) said it is increasing cargo rates by 50 centimes/kilo on its Paris-Seoul route and onward destinations to the Far East and Pacific, effective April 1.
"The increases work out at around five to seven percent and are in response to a positive market outlook," a Paris-based KAL cargo official told Reuters.
KAL last increased its ex-Paris rates in April 1996.
KAL operates a twice-weekly Boeing 747-200F Paris-Seoul service in conjunction with Air France.
The Korean airline is to add an extra 747-400 passenger flight on the same route, with the introduction of summer schedules, taking the number of weekly frequencies to five, the official said.
"This will provide an additional 12 to 15 tonnes of cargo capacity per week." -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
